subject: Decision Making
title: Food Placement Nudges
description: A 60-second lesson on Food Placement Nudges.

hook.text: Google moved candy into opaque jars and placed fruit in clear bowls.

buildup.text: Brian Wansink showed that visibility and proximity control eating.

discovery.text: Cafeteria nudges work at scale. Smaller plates reduce portions. Taller glasses reduce liquid intake.

twist.text: Wansink's bottomless soup bowl experiment showed people ate 73% more without realizing.

climax.text: You do not need a diet. You need a redesigned kitchen. Move junk out of sight. Put fruit at eye level.

punchline.text: Hide candy, show fruit. 3.1 million fewer calories. Design beats willpower.

quiz.question: How did Google reduce candy consumption?
options: Moved candy into opaque jars and placed fruit in clear bowls at eye level
